messages.subject: Retired pi-orca package
messages.body: Created the standalone local orca-development skill, added the Taskdesk AGENTS.md workflow pointer as an uncommitted project instruction edit, and committed/pushed the tooling README retirement update. Validation found the local skill parses and is actually discovered provider-free by Pi RPC with exactly one user-scope command, README has no private absolute paths, Taskdesk has only the intended AGENTS.md tracked diff plus pre-existing untracked files, and GitHub reports alexradunet/pi-orca-subagents archived at commit 68304667c1ffd04fd2e575cab31fcd6bc6e2541b. What remains is only for existing Pi sessions to reload/restart if they need the new skill list; old packages/settings/checkouts were intentionally left in place.
